summary: Iteration 9 focused on the sub-game topic propagation feature (POST /api/subgames/propagate-topic + SubJogos.js). Backend: 7 pytest tests (login/httpOnly cookie, propagate to all GKs except owner with note=''/evaluation='' and new uuid, metric definition preserved, metric_result computed per GK via GET /api/goalkeepers/{id}/subgames, dedup by name (also case-insensitive), edit-not-propagate, delete-not-propagate, empty name no-op, auth required) -> 7/7 passed. Frontend E2E (Playwright, real UI, admin login): created 'QATEST Ocupacao UI' on GK Bernardo Paçó (verde + Tomada de decisão/Ocupar espaço + nota 'observação X'); it appeared on Daniel Osuji and Gonçalo Portugal WITHOUT note and WITHOUT eval colour dot, with per-GK metric recalculated (Osuji 22 ações / 64%, owner 0/0). Re-creating the same name did not duplicate on other GKs. Editing note/eval on GK2 did not affect GK3. Deleting on GK2 did not remove it on GK3. All 5 requested flows PASS. Test data cleaned surgically (QATEST prefix only) - DB scan confirms zero leftovers.

minor.issue: Propagation is a separate non-transactional call after PUT /subgames; if it fails the frontend swallows the error (catch {}) yet still shows the success toast 'Tópico guardado e adicionado aos restantes guarda-redes.' - user can be misled. Suggest surfacing a warning toast on failure.
Accepts duplicate topic names on the SAME goalkeeper: re-creating 'QATEST Ocupacao UI' on GK1 produced 2 identical cards on GK1 (others correctly stayed at 1). No same-GK name dedup/validation.
No brute-force lockout after N failed attempts (playbook item 4) - unlimited login attempts allowed. Pre-existing, not part of this iteration's change.
allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True if CORS_ORIGINS is unset - invalid combination for cookie auth; ensure explicit origins remain configured in .env.

action_items: Optional: block/warn on duplicate topic name within the same goalkeeper + sub-game (currently creates a duplicate card on the origin GK).
Optional: don't show the success toast when /subgames/propagate-topic fails (error currently silently ignored in SubJogos.js saveTopic).
critical_code_review_comments: SubJogos.js saveTopic(): `catch { /* ignore */ }` around propagate-topic hides real failures; log/toast a warning instead.

propagate_topic() reads and rewrites the whole `subgames` doc per GK (read-modify-write); concurrent saves could lose topics. A $push with an $elemMatch-based dedup or an atomic pipeline update would be safer.
server.py is 1384 lines - consider splitting into routers (auth, goalkeepers, subgames, reports/PDF).
seed_data_creation: Only temporary topics prefixed 'QATEST' inside existing goalkeepers' subgame_evals; all removed after testing (verified by DB scan). No collections deleted, no real data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Propagation feature validated end-to-end (backend + UI) in iteration 9; regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration9_propagate.py cleans up its own QATEST topics via module fixture and preserves other sub-games (get_all/put_subgame helpers). UI notes: sj-gk-select is a native select (use select_option and wait ~2.5s for reload); goalkeepers list takes 1-3s to populate; metric text lives in [data-testid^='sj-metric-']; note is rendered as p.text-xs; eval colour is span.rounded-full.shrink-0. Remaining known gaps: no same-GK duplicate-name validation, no login brute-force lockout.
rca_of_the_issue: No defect found in the propagation logic. Duplicate cards on the origin GK come from the frontend pushing the new topic into the local array without a name check, while the backend dedups only for other GKs.
